gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: The 2021 year of account is the first to be closed for the syndicate via RITC. The result was a net combined ratio of 99.0% versus the SBF plan of 95.8%, which yielded a total recognized gain of GBP 2.14m. The deviation from plan is driven by greater expense costs in a high inflation environment, as well as the impact of a tighter reinsurance market than planned. Incurred experience to date is 13.1% better than expected in terms of the GULR, which is currently forecast to be only 2% favourable to plan at 49.6%. The 2022 year of account has moved adversely to plan during the last twelve months, with a forecast net combined ratio of 101.5% resulting in a total recognized loss of GBP 2.88m. This movement was primarily driven by claims movements in Transactional Liability and Environmental that appear to suggest faster development than initially expected.

Conversely, the 2022 year of account saw a recognized loss of $2.88 million, primarily due to faster-than-expected claims development in Transactional Liability and Environmental lines.
